Vacancies for Faculty
Tuesday, 28 July 2015
8561 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts-
1. Assistant professor in General Surgery (4)
2. Assistant professor in Radiodaignosis (2)
3. Assistant professor in Medicine
4. Assistant professor in Anesthesia (2)
5. Assistant professor in Pediatrics
6. Assistant professor in Ophthalmology
7. Assistant professor in Orthopedics
8. Assistant professor in Skin VD
9. Assistant professor in Radiotherapy
10.  Assistant professor in Pathology
The applicant should send their application to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
25th Augus
t
2015
. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: As per the Medical Council of India norms
Pay Scale:    15600 - 39100 with grade pay of 6000/-
Age Limit:     35 years. Age can be relaxed for exceptional and suitable candidates.
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
